name: Falabella Colombia
body: HSTS, framing limited to its origin, and robots.txt that lists its sitemaps. But the home page's <html> tag has no lang attribute, so screen readers and translators must guess it's Spanish.
lesson: Add lang="es-CO" to the <html> tag in your base template. One attribute fixes every page.
summary: www.falabella.com.co scores 60 out of 100 (D). 6 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 16 pass. Fix first: 51 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 51 form controls have no label
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 13 cookies are sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: __CO_exp, experience, seller_experience, brand_experience and 9 more. Without HttpOnly: sid. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /falabella-co, /falabella-co/basket, /falabella-co/page/Vende-en-falabella-com and 10…
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: 3 JSON-LD blocks do not parse
fix.fix: Validate each block with the Schema Markup Validator and fix the JSON.

fix.title: The start page does not declare its language
fix.evidence: Screen readers pick the wrong voice and browsers offer the wrong translation.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: Some pages are closed to AI answer crawlers
fix.evidence: OAI-SearchBot cannot read 1 page, ChatGPT-User cannot read 1 page, Claude-SearchBot cannot read 1 page, Claude-User cannot read 1 page.
fix.fix: Check that the closed paths are meant to stay out of AI answers.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page arrived in 201 ms
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Language alternates point at each other
The start page sets a mobile viewport
